eyecite_notes: metadata.year is unreliable when a citation has no year parenthetical or another citation follows soon after: on this filing eyecite reports year 2019 for Eastern Airlines v. Floyd, 499 U.S. 530 (1991) and for Shaboon (2013 IL App), both in the .txt and in the PDF text. Take the year from a regex on the ~40 chars after the cite (e.g. r'\((?:[^()]*?\s)?(\d{4})\)') and fall back to metadata.year.
eyecite reports court=None for '(3d Cir. 1999)' (Greenleaf) although it resolves '2d Cir.', '11th Cir.', 'D.C. Cir.', 'D.D.C.', 'Tex. App.', 'Ga. Ct. App.'.

reporters_db REPORTERS is keyed by the base reporter: 'F.' holds editions F., F.2d, F.3d, F.4th; 'F. Supp.' holds F. Supp., F. Supp. 2d, F. Supp. 3d. 'IL App (1st)' has cite_type 'neutral'; 'WL' has cite_type 'specialty_west'.
The unrecognized reporter 'Fed. Air Rptr. 3d' yields no citation at all; the regex catch on uncovered spans is required for item unrec-alvarez.
